criteria.text: Identifies the conflict between the 30-day claim notice period in SPA Section 9.7 and the 45-day period in Escrow Clause 5.2, and recommends the Buyer works to the shorter 30-day period or aligns the documents.

Identifies the threatened $3,400,000 claim by Foxley Energy plc recorded in the board minutes and that it is not disclosed against the litigation warranty (Warranty 7.1), recommending a specific indemnity or price protection.
Identifies that the basket in SPA Section 9.4 ($675,000) operates as a deductible (Seller liable only for the excess), not a tipping basket, and explains that this is less favourable to the Buyer.
Calculates the Earn-out Payment as $3,000,000 (2 x ($8,600,000 - $6,500,000), subject to the $3,000,000 cap) and identifies that the Seller's figure of $2,600,000 is wrong.
Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 9.2 is stated as $27,000,000 but 25% of the $135,000,000 Purchase Price is $33,750,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.
Shows the earn-out arithmetic and flags the discrepancy between $3,000,000 and the Seller's $2,600,000.
Where a defined term or clause is ambiguous, explains how each alternative reading would work.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
